excel_template.queryString: select distinct decode(MAIN_POS,'000100','HỘI SỞ CHÍNH','000101','SỞ GIAO DỊCH',upper(add_city)) str1 from po850mb where POS_CD=$P{PV_POS_CD}
select initcap(replace(PO_TEN,'PGD','')) str1 from dmpos where PO_MA=$P{PV_POS_CD}

queryString.description: Lấy thông tin khách hàng trực tiếp

excel_template.queryString: select ROWNUM STR1, STR2, STR3, STR4, STR5 FROM (select NVL(CUST_NAME,' ') STR2, NVL(CUST_ID,' ') STR3, NVL(ADDRESS,' ') STR4,NVL( MOBILE,' ') STR5 from DTW_COL_CUST_MOBILE where POS_CD = $P{PV_POS_CD} and GROUP_ID is null and MASS_ORG is null and status ='A' order by COMMUNE_ID, CUST_ID)
